_comment: ANHONI story seeds — premium Hindi suspense/thriller/mystery premises (fiction, evergreen, policy-safe: NO gore/rape/graphic). Date-rotated, one per day. Add more anytime.
seeds: Aadhi raat, ek akeli ladki cab me baithi hai; driver baar-baar peeche dekhta hai aur kehta hai 'is sadak pe kisi ko mat rok'na'.
Naye ghar me shift hote hi biwi ko har raat 3 baje ek bachche ke rone ki aawaz aati hai; par unka koi bachcha nahi hai.
Ek aadmi ko roz ek anjaan number se apni hi aane wali ghatnaon ke message aate hain; aaj wale message me uski maut likhi hai.
Building ka watchman naye kirayedaar ko flat 7B lene se mana karta hai; pichhla parivaar ek raat achanak gayab ho gaya tha.
Ek behen apni gum-shuda bhen ke phone se aayi aakhri video dekhti hai; usme peeche koi khada tha jo tab dikha nahi tha.
Office me raat ki shift; lift har baar 4th floor pe apne aap rukti hai, jabki 4th floor band pada hai.
Ek jodi purana aaina kharidta hai; usme unki parchhai unse ek pal der se hilti hai.
Ek maa apne bete ke naye 'dost' se milti hai jise koi aur dekh nahi paata.
Ek shaks ko har subah apne darwaze par ek nayi tasveer milti hai — kal raat ki uski khud ki, sote hue.
Puraane gaon me lautne par ek aadmi ko sab pehchante hain, par woh kisi ko nahi; sab kehte hain woh 10 saal pehle ja chuka tha.
Ek nurse night duty pe; room no. 302 ka mareez roz mar jaata hai aur agli raat phir wahi baithe milta hai.
Ek ladki ki nayi flatmate bilkul usi jaisi dikhti hai, usi jaisi baat karti hai — dheere dheere uski zindagi le rahi hai.
Ek driver ko GPS ek aisi sadak pe le jaata hai jo kisi map pe hai hi nahi; waha ek dhaba hai jo 20 saal pehle jal chuka tha.
Har baar jab ghadi 2:17 dikhati hai, ghar ka ek darwaza apne aap ek inch khul jaata hai.
Ek aadmi apni purani diary padhta hai aur paata hai ki usme kal ki, abhi tak na hui, ghatnaayein likhi hain.
Ek couple ki honeymoon photos me har frame me ek anjaan aurat door khadi dikhti hai — jise unhone kabhi nahi dekha.
Building ki chhat pe raat ko koi bachcha gend khelta sunai deta hai; us building me koi bachcha rehta hi nahi.
Ek shaks ko apni hi shakl ka aadmi shehar me ghoomta dikhta hai, uske naam se, uski zindagi jeeta hua.
Ek purani haveli ki naukri; sirf ek shart — raat 12 baje ke baad neeche wale kamre me jhaank ke mat dekhna.
Ek ladki ko uske mare hue dost ke Instagram se roz stories aati hain — usi jagah ki jaha woh abhi khadi hai.
Train ka aakhri dabba; ek boodhi aurat kehti hai 'beta, agla station mat utarna' — aur khud gayab ho jaati hai.
Ek aadmi ki nayi smartwatch uski heartbeat dikhati hai — par ek aur dil ki dhadkan bhi, jo uske bilkul paas hai.
Ghar me lagi nayi CCTV har raat 3 baje 4 minute ke liye apne aap band ho jaati hai; aaj usne record kar liya.
Ek teacher ki class me ek naya bachcha roz aata hai jiska naam register me nahi; baaki bachche kehte hain woh akela baithta hai... khidki ke bahar.
